name: insuaminca-medidas-apk
description: Paquete compilado de INSUAMINCA Control de Medidas y Pesos para generar APK Android

scripts.apk:prepare: npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.apk:build: npm run apk:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.apk:release: npm run apk:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon
